turrets.prompt: Production game sprite atlas, 4 columns by 4 rows, equal cells, transparent RGBA background, no text or grid lines. Cute hand-painted original toy tower-defense turrets for a carrot garden. No plants, pea-shooter mouths, sunflowers, leaves or pots. Rows 1-3: rotating weapon heads pointing up, consistent camera/scale/registration, four generated keyframes each: neutral, recoil with muzzle flash, recovering with fading flash, neutral. Row 1 coral-red and cream candy cannon with brass and turquoise details. Row 2 turquoise/periwinkle ice crystal turret in cream mechanical fork. Row 3 golden-orange/red twin firework rocket turret. Row 4 stationary low round ivory swivel bases with corresponding colored trim in cells 1-3; cell 4 empty. Warm brown outlines, soft painted highlights, readable at small size, generous transparent margins.

runtime: Bases remain fixed. Generated heads/keyframes are registered to swivel pivots and exported in 32 orientations in four-frame strips; no procedural replacement for generated animation frames.
